import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
m=re.search(r'Test input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t); h,w=int(m[1]),int(m[2])
rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
test=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
# crop to rows/cols containing 8
rows8=[r for r in range(len(test)) if any(x==8 for x in test[r])]
cols8={c for c in range(len(test[0])) if any(test[r][c]==8 for r in rows8)}
out=[row[min(cols8):max(cols8)+1] for row in test[max(rows8): ] if max(rows8)<=len(test)-1]
# build properly
rr=min(rows8); cc=min(cols8)
out=[row[cc:] for row in test[rr:]]
print(len(out),len(out[0]))
